# Introduction

This webbook contains summary statistics and visualisations for the second EHI data release.

## Accession numbers

The ENA accession numbers can be found in the sample and raw data metadata tables stored in the GitHub repository:

> https://github.com/earthhologenome/EHI_data_release_2/tree/main/data

The FASTA files of the 11,538 metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) are archived in Zenodo:

> https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23011783

## Prepare the R environment

### Environment

To reproduce all the analyses locally, clone this repository in your computer using:

```
RStudio > New Project > Version Control > Git
```

And indicating the following git repository:

> https://github.com/earthhologenome/EHI_data_release_2.git

Once the R project has been created, follow the instructions and code chunks shown in this webbook.

### Libraries

The following R packages are required for the data analysis.

```{r load_libraries, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
# Base
library(R.utils)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(devtools)
library(tinytable)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggtree)
library(ape)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggh4x)
library(phytools)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggrepel)
```
